title: An empirical investigation on the correlation between solar cell cracks and hotspots
mechanism: Classifies cracks into four modes (free, micro-crack, shaded / isolated area, breakdown) and measures which produce hot spots.
evidence: R: 12 cells; modes 1-2 no hot spot; modes 3-4 heat from 25 C to 100 C; worst at 40 to 60 % shading ratio (105 C).
adaptation: Gives a severity label computable from our masks (crack mode from predicted inactive fraction) and the EL-to-thermal mapping for the deliverable; explains why thermal cannot help strict crack IoU.
min_experiment: With E-PF masks on A3 crack modules (needs Om's open decision on inference location), Spearman between predicted inactive fraction per cell and sunlit IR cell delta T; kill the mapping claim if rho < 0.3.
prior_overlap: Desk study (doc 22) cited the abstract; no experiment run.
